Characteristics [Category]: bulk ATAC-seq chromatin accessibility profiling of a human cutaneous melanoma cell line
Material Type: Bulk Assay for Transposase-Accessible Chromatin using sequencing (bulk ATAC-seq) on SK-MEL-28 cells, a lightly pigmented cutaneous malignant melanoma line from skin of a 51-year-old male and a melanocyte-derived cancer model included in major pharmacogenomic resources.
Parameter [dna_extraction]: Bulk ATAC-seq nuclei preparation from adherent melanoma cells: nuclei are isolated from the cultured population and open chromatin regions are tagmented by Tn5 transposase before library amplification and sequencing.
